en.headline: Commodities working group holds first meeting
en.dek: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui chaired the panel created in this year's Policy Address, with gold as the first focus.
body: The Joint Working Group on Commodities Trading held its first meeting on Wednesday, chaired by the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Christopher Hui.

The government said the group discussed policy direction and targets for developing commodities trading in Hong Kong, as well as market trends and the city's potential. Members include representatives of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the Securities and Futures Commission, the Insurance Authority and Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing. Other bureaux and the operator of the planned precious metals clearing system may join as needed.

Hui said global commodities markets are shifting and that Hong Kong, while keeping its existing financial strengths, is opening a new growth line. He said the authorities are using gold as the entry point to build an international commodities trading ecosystem, in line with the national 15th Five-Year Plan.

The working group, proposed in the 2026 Policy Address, is to follow up priority projects and draw up a roadmap aimed at making Hong Kong a hub that combines trading, clearing, warehousing, pricing and financing.

zh.headline: 大宗商品交易聯合工作組召開首次會議
zh.dek: 財庫局局長許正宇主持施政報告提出的工作組首次會議，表明以黃金為切入點推進交易生態圈。
body: 由財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇領導的「大宗商品交易聯合工作組」星期三召開首次會議，討論發展本港大宗商品交易的政策方向和目標，並探討市場趨勢及香港的發展潛力。
工作組在今年施政報告提出成立，成員包括金管局、證監會、保監局及港交所代表。其他政策局和部門，以及香港貴金屬中央結算系統有限公司等機構代表，將按需要出席。
許正宇表示，全球大宗商品市場格局正在轉變，香港在鞏固現有金融市場優勢的同時，亦主動開辟新增長點。當局正以黃金為切入點，全速推進國際大宗商品交易生態圈建設，對接國家「十五五」規劃。
他說，工作組會貫徹《香港特別行政區經濟和社會發展五年規劃（2026-2030年）》的部署，將香港打造為集交易、清算、倉儲、定價及融資於一體的國際大宗商品樞紐，並繼續跟進優先項目，訂出發展路線圖。
